parameters.description:
Context7 indexes library documentation and serves it on demand. One tool resolves a package name to a library id, the other queries that library's docs — so an answer about an API reflects the version you name rather than whatever the model absorbed at training time. Anonymous use is rate-limited by the upstream.

No credentials required: the upstream is public and this listing adds no key of its own. Enrol and the tools appear in your client prefixed `context7__`, reached through the one UnitySVC MCP endpoint you already configured.
parameters.summary: Pull up-to-date documentation for a library or framework, version-aware, without leaving your AI client.
